cohort: 1508 women giving live birth in a single hospital in Shanghai in December 2022.
finding: While Omicron infection during pregnancy was associated with higher maternal fever across all delivery modes, only the vaginal delivery subgroup showed higher preterm birth rates and lower umbilical artery pH; other outcomes were comparable.
mod_finding: Among women who delivered vaginally, those who tested positive for COVID-19 had higher rates of preterm birth.
